structureTypeSource: Grob G 103 C Twin III Acro: glass-fibre (GFRP) composite fuselage shell.

limits._comment: Not wired (the sim has no field for them): VRA 200, VT 185, VW 140 km/h ([POH] 2.2, [TCDS] N.III.7). Without OSB 315-66: VNE 250, VA = VRA = VT 170 km/h, no aerobatics ([POH] 2.2A) -- not modelled.

loading._cgDatumNote: [POH] 2.7: datum = wing root leading edge = body x 0, the frame cgForwardLimitM / cgAftLimitM (270-480 mm aft) are already written in.
loading._comment: Arms: [N41KP] weighing, front seat 1132 mm in front of the datum, rear 35 mm behind, baggage 810 mm behind; datum = wing root leading edge = body x 0 ([POH] 2.7). Max seat loads 110 kg, min front 70 kg ([POH] 2.10); baggage 10 kg ([POH] 2.6). Trim weights: up to two of 5.6 kg at 1543 mm (one) / 1560 mm (two) in front of the datum ([POH] 6.4). CG range 270-480 mm aft of datum ([POH] 2.7). No water ballast ([POH] 7.10: removable ballast is the trim weights only). Eye points are derived, not published (derivation sec. 7).

airspeed._unitsSource: JUDGEMENT: modern glass two-seater, and its modelled panel ALREADY drives airspeed_kias (tools/own_models/grob103_cockpit.py). FLAGGED: its POH and its painted face art are in km/h; the game has no km/h unit and adding one for one type is not what was decided, so the art is left as built.
airspeed._unitsRule: Ty 2026-11-10, asked what rule the other 27 types follow after settling five by hand, chose "by era and category": "Vintage, fabric and experimental types read mph; anything certified modern or turbine reads knots." FlyingGame.Core.Instruments.AsiUnits carries the rule and the exceptions.
